text: Richard Wright's Native Son was challenged in Goffstown, NH, in 1978, and in Elmwood Park, NJ, the same year because of its “objectionable” language. In 1981 it was challenged in North Adams, MA, because of its “violence, sex, and profanity.”
meta_description: Native Son by Richard Wright: challenged in Goffstown, NH and Elmwood Park, NJ in 1978 and North Adams, MA in 1981.
